task: Build an e-commerce application with authentication, product catalog, search, shopping cart, Stripe checkout, secure Stripe webhooks, PostgreSQL database, inventory management, order history, and automated tests.

requirements.title: User authentication
requirements.description: Users must be able to register and authenticate securely.

requirements.title: Product catalog
requirements.description: Users must be able to browse products.

requirements.title: Search and filtering
requirements.description: Users must be able to search and filter available content.

requirements.title: Shopping cart
requirements.description: Users must be able to manage products in a shopping cart.
acceptanceCriteria: Products can be added to the cart

requirements.title: Stripe checkout
requirements.description: The application must provide a secure server-side Stripe checkout flow.
acceptanceCriteria: Successful checkout has a confirmation flow

requirements.title: Secure webhook handling
requirements.description: Webhook events must be authenticated before processing.

requirements.title: Database persistence
requirements.description: Application data must be persisted in the required database.

requirements.title: Inventory management
requirements.description: Product inventory must be checked and safely updated.
acceptanceCriteria: Stock is reduced after successful purchase
Concurrent inventory updates are handled safely

requirements.title: Order history
requirements.description: Authenticated users must be able to view their previous orders.
acceptanceCriteria: Order items and totals are displayed

requirements.title: Automated tests
requirements.description: Critical application behavior must be covered by automated tests.
